proof_summary: For the candidate linear-recurrence sequence \(c_n\), the proof studies the defect \(d_n=c_{n+1}^2-c_nc_{n+2}\): induction gives rapid positive growth of \(c_n\), the recurrence \(d_{n+3}=4d_{n+1}+d_n\), and hence \(0<d_n\le c_n\). Thus \(c_n c_{n+2}<c_{n+1}^2\le c_n(c_{n+2}+1)\), which forces the prescribed ceiling-minus-one step to equal \(c_{n+2}\); induction then identifies the nonlinearly defined terms with the candidate sequence.
